mechanism: Both drugs can impair renal function and increase risk of acute kidney injury; zoledronic acid may cause hypocalcemia which could be compounded by empagliflozin's effects on electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, eGFR, and electrolytes (calcium, phosphate) regularly; ensure adequate hydration before zoledronic acid infusion; assess renal function before initiating empagliflozin in patients receiving bisphosphonates.
